scope: Current requirements and interaction contract; not a declaration of native or physical-device acceptance.

routes.primaryContract: PRD §7.9 PTS-CLUB-01–16: member-owned earn, wallet, expiry and all-catalog redemption.
contract: Wallet and care actions appear independently of optional address/catalog reads. Loading, missing data and request failure are separate states.
Daily product chips allow multiple selections. A pending unknown command freezes its submitted content and retries the original key and payload.
Redemption shows real product, quantity, stock, points total and chosen address before explicit confirmation. Stock/price/policy/address changes require another confirmation.
A saved unknown redemption is resolved only under the original canonical member and environment. Absence is not failure; abandoning writes a serialized server tombstone.
Hide/unload invalidates reads; account change clears private state. Ledger and redemptions have explicit loading-more and retry states.
Native scroll and safe-area footer keep actions reachable with large text and keyboard; buttons show busy/disabled state. Motion must not determine business success.

routes.primaryContract: PRD §7.9 PTS-CLUB-04/09/10/15: capability-scoped fulfillment, catalog promotion, rule version approval and ledger reconciliation.
contract: Show only sections supported by current server-issued capabilities; each mutation independently rechecks authority and version.
Fulfillment uses an exact redemption, expected version, real carrier/tracking facts and explicit action. Returns require an owner request and actual returned-goods confirmation.

Every normal catalog SKU derives points from its published price; no separate gift whitelist or member quota. Product promotion can be 1x or 3x with expected version and an audit reason; existing orders retain their snapshot.

A future rule is proposed with all fields and approved by another authorized member before effect. Monthly issuance is reporting/reminder only. Reconciliation exposes discrepancies without rewriting a balance.
Unknown writes require original-result verification before another action; stale/read failures retain known facts and expose retry. Hide/unload and session change invalidate ownership.
All operations remain reachable through native scrolling, safe areas and labeled controls, including large text; no UI action grants authority.
